name: context-meter
description: Claude's context window as a meter: how full it is (a bar that grows and a percentage that counts) and the pieces of text taking up the room, one row each with its share.

used.description: percent full; counts and grows between steps

caption.description: a line under the bar, e.g. `illustrative, not measured`

share.description: its share, as text, e.g. `40%` or `tiny`

tone.description: brief: standing instructions (CLAUDE.md); file: a file it read; output: a command's output; chat: your messages and its replies; summary: a compacted summary; waste: something that didn't need to be there
